en.hubeali:
From Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Basheer, from Ibn Muzarib, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not cut down the fruit-bearing trees, for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Send upon you a difficult Punishment’.
en.sarwar: 9. It is narrated from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Al-Husayn ibn Bashir from ibn Mudarib who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
You must not cut down a fruit bearing tree; Allah will send on you a great suffering.’”
